entries.title: Voluntary tactical intervals
entries.expectedBehavior: Pressing T outside an initiated encounter starts a voluntary tactical interval without changing the actor's held AP or movement allowance.
entries.rationale: Turn mode is available for precise positioning and environment interaction even when nobody is hostile.
entries.playerTip: Enter turn mode whenever precision helps; completing the interval lets the environment answer before the next one.

entries.title: Completing a voluntary interval
entries.expectedBehavior: Pressing Space while no action is resolving ends this interval, records its final actor state, and locks player commands during the matching world turn. Completing that phase adds the scenario AP income up to its held cap and restores movement. Pressing T returns to exploration without replenishing resources; a new voluntary interval remains locked until one minimum world turn has elapsed.
entries.rationale: Repeated voluntary intervals are allowed because the world receives one corresponding opportunity to act for every interval the player completes.
entries.playerTip: Press Space for another tactical interval, or press T to complete the interval and return to exploration.

entries.title: Provisional route planning
entries.expectedBehavior: The authoritative actor remains still while WASD extends the route. The ghost, destination, and displayed cost are previews until Enter confirms them.
entries.rationale: Planning cannot spend movement or change position until one deterministic route record is accepted.
entries.playerTip: Use Backspace to remove the last segment, R to cancel the whole route, and Enter to commit.

entries.title: Authoritative movement playback
entries.expectedBehavior: A confirmed route spends movement once and plays to its recorded destination and final facing. Turn-mode exit remains blocked until playback completes.
entries.rationale: The presentation follows the accepted record so frame rate and animation cannot change the gameplay result.
entries.playerTip: Wait for movement to resolve before planning again or pressing T to exit turn mode.

entries.title: Initiated encounter economy
entries.expectedBehavior: An initiated encounter owns the current AP, movement, cooldowns, and initiative. Leaving turn mode cannot refresh them while the encounter remains active.
entries.rationale: Mandatory hostile turns, impacts, and other encounter events must resolve inside one continuous authoritative economy.
entries.playerTip: Press Space to end the active actor's turn. Exit turn mode remains blocked until the encounter is resolved.

entries.title: Objective interaction available
entries.expectedBehavior: The raised-deck object exposes its own interaction and turn cost when the actor is inside its authored interaction radius. Exploration interactions do not consume stored turn resources.
entries.rationale: The target owns the behavior and cost; its in-range prompt invokes only the interaction offered by that object.
entries.playerTip: Press E while inside the marker to secure the raised-deck objective.

entries.title: Raised deck secured
entries.expectedBehavior: The raised-deck objective remains complete after its accepted interaction record, independent of animation speed or rendering frame rate.
entries.rationale: Objective completion belongs to the gameplay session and is replayed from the resolved action record.
entries.playerTip: Press T to exit a voluntary turn interval and return to exploration.
